newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Hyundai may build Lithuania bus plant.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai may build Lithuania bus plant.

text.p: South Korean vehicle maker Hyundai is still uncertain where it will build a bus assembly plant in the Baltic states but it is beginning to favour Lithuania, Estonian newspaper Aripaev said on Monday.
Aripaev quoted Hyundai's auto division manager Sang-jun Yoon as saying that a plant would be built in the country which showed most interest in its buses.
"At the moment, Lithuania has shown the greatest interest and we have good cooperation developing there," Sang-jun told the newspaper.
Lithuania is planning to buy 80 emergency vehicles and 57 buses from Hyundai.

The newspaper said that Hyundai had for some time been considering building an assembly plant in the Baltics but that no decision had been made yet. The size of the planned investment is also not yet known.
